title: Barefoot Pianist
content: James Fitzwilliamaccompanied the Bard College Symphonic Chorus in a concert last night. I painted him in watercolor and gouache from the fourth row of the audience.Fitzwilliamsis a dedicatedbarefooterall year round, including in the winter. He says that "it provides during performances the benefit of increased sensitivity to the instrument and better pedal control at both the organ and the piano."Previously posts about sketching in concerts:James Bagwell ConductsMaestro BagwellJames Bagwell at a RehearsalThe "Flash-Glance" MethodGouache portrait of an Irish whistle playerSketching a vocal concertViolinist in ink washHorn PlayerMirko ListeningClub Passim GigShapewelding SketchingThe Cello and the PencilConcertgoerMass in CHandel's MessiahIrish Fiddler Dylan Foley
